notes: REVISION 2 (Codex, found during the junkwell-02 merge, 10-07 evening; both engines APPROVE after rounds 7-10): (1) EVERY BANKABLE COUNT FOLLOWS THE SWITCH -- bankableInventory's noSwords defaults to the switch (foodskip peacefulFoodActive; off = the base rule exactly); admission's deposit-due test, depositWorthIt, and on the towndeposit variant the town-deposit trigger and skill read it at the call (foodSkipNow), so a spare sword never makes a deposit due, advised, planned or offered while peaceful. (2) THE DRAIN NEVER CLOSES ON A LOADED CURSOR WITHOUT A TRY -- a take that stopped between its two clicks leaves the item on the cursor; vanilla returns it to the bag at the close when there is room and DROPS it when the bag is full (Paper probe, sandbox/craft/pk-cursor-probe.mjs). The drain puts it back into the bag (returnCursor), else into the furnace slot it came from. New `_sword_fuel` rows: 'left in the furnace fuel slot (the cursor could not be emptied into the bag)' (credited), '... (the drain ran out of time)' (credited), 'put back into the furnace fuel slot from the cursor (left by an earlier call)' (NOT credited: that sword was credited when it left the bag), 'on the cursor at the close (the server returns it to the bag)' (no credit, no breach), 'on the cursor at the close (the server drops it)' (a K2 BREACH). A call that took an earlier call's sword back marks its next sink row ` restaged=1` (no credit: the same sword, no new departure). REVISION 1 (OWNER 10-07 ~19:50Z, before any launch): (1) SWORDS -- banking REMOVED ('no reason to store swords at all'): while the switch is on no sword is ever banked, not even a spare (bankableInventory noSwords). No-craft and no-chase kept. A smelt that is ALREADY happening prefers carried WOODEN swords as fuel, one per item, before ordinary fuel; a sword never starts a smelt; the switch is re-read before each sword goes in; one `_sword_fuel` row per sword. Stone swords stay in the bag (junkwell-02 disposes of them, importing peacefulkit.mjs unwantedSword). (2) SAPLINGS under the switch: oak and birch keep 16, every other species none. (3) COMPOST + dried_kelp, glow_berries, moss_carpet, firefly_bush, bush, bread (each 64/64 in the Paper hopper test; bread off when not peaceful). (4) THE GUARD is general: the town order counts the real surplus after every reserve and only when a fill can start, whatever the switch says. Paper: wooden_sword in a real furnace = 1 ingot then gone; stone_sword not fuel. REVIEWED (both engines APPROVE after six rounds on the revision; the code reviewed at fe369a8, f2c4ba0 adds tests only) -- the furnace path: a sword goes in ONLY when the fuel slot is empty and the furnace is COLD (mineflayer furnace.fuel === 0 or the block's `lit` false; found on Paper: furnace.fuel reads null for a cold furnace because mineflayer attaches its listener after the open), so it ignites at once and the switch read at the put IS the switch at the burn. `_sword_fuel` rows, written after the furnace window closes (mineflayer copies the window's bag into bot.inventory only at the close): 'burned wooden_sword' (confirmed: the slot emptied while burning, or the item cooked), 'burned wooden_sword (unconfirmed)' (the slot emptied, never seen burning), 'wooden_sword returned unburned' (it never ignited; also '(left by an earlier call)'), 'wooden_sword left in the furnace fuel slot (the bag is full)' (never tossed: the room is checked on the window right before the take), 'wooden_sword outcome unknown (the furnace could not be read)' (no credit). A wooden sword an earlier call left in the fuel slot is taken back before any input goes in; with no empty slot the job does not start (inventory_full); if the take fails with the sword still there, no input goes in (container_blocked). EXPECTED SIDE EFFECTS: a sword smelt waits up to one poll per sword for a cold furnace, so under a short stuck window a call can finish fewer items (Paper: the harness's 20 s window stopped 1 of 2 items; the fleet's 35 s window 2/2); while on, saplings of species other than oak and birch are composted, so planting of those species stops by design; `_compost` rows carry args.items / incomplete / inflight and an 'aborted' status. Never toss or drop. (4) COMPOST MORE ... the plant items that are useless in a peaceful world'. MEASURED (fleet c6e91a8, 12 h to 10-07 17:30Z, 80 bots, 441 bot-h): 68 stone + 55 wooden swords in 73 of 80 bags (123 slots, ~4.9% of used slots), 1 sword crafted in 12 h, 3 sword craft proposals in 70,115 decisions in 24 h, 0 sword pickups by the sweep; 24 h sword ledger: 1 banked spare, 1 snapshot blip, 0 lost. Kit-plant stock ~165 slots (wildflowers 34, melon_slice 27, brown_mushroom 26, kelp 19, red_mushroom 12, rose_bush 9, cocoa_beans 9, peony 8 ...). THE CHANGE (bots/src/peacefulkit.mjs + foodskip/bankable/composter/skills/admission/prompt/cognitive): FOOD_SKIP=auto|on|off (default auto = the server's difficulty packet says peaceful; foodskip.mjs attachDifficulty now refreshes the in-process decision from every packet). Swords: admission refuses craft <sword> (peaceful_no_sword, remedy 'craft a pickaxe, axe or shovel, or gather instead'), the craft skill refuses it at depth 0, the prompt stops offering one, the sweep does not walk to a sword drop, and a RUNNING deposit keeps no sword (every usable copy goes; spent copies never; the base keeps the best copy of each name); admission/advice/milestone counts keep the base rule, so a sword never makes a deposit due (no new trip). Compost: the town composter also takes 30 kit plants WHOLE (melon_slice, kelp, brown/red mushroom, cocoa_beans, sweet_berries, torchflower_seeds, pitcher_pod, every small/tall flower incl. wildflowers, pink_petals, cactus_flower, torchflower, pitcher_plant, eyeblossoms, wither_rose); saplings above 16/species and apples above 4 unchanged; dried_kelp, glow_berries, bush, firefly_bush, moss_carpet, dry grass, bread NOT approved; startableJunk stops no-op compost orders on full bags while the switch is on (fillDecision at the composter's level) -- A SECOND EFFECT IN THIS VARIABLE: it also applies to the food policy's apple-only full bags, so compost-visit counts can differ between arms there too; `_compost` rows carry args.items (complete map) + args.peaceful, also on interrupted visits (status aborted, args.incomplete when an insert was in flight); a deposit whose only eligible copies are the kit's swords never starts the full-chest recovery or closes the bank; one `_peaceful_kit` row per process per change of (decision, difficulty). extension.note: Compost visits need a full bag at town. Measured X2 power (distinct bots, random draws of whole pools): 6 h 0.39-0.99 (2 pools) / 0.59-1.00 (3); 24 h >= 0.99. No KEEP before exposure; at the deadline INCONCLUSIVE.

require.name: compost visits (the town composter is used here)
deposits that moved items (the bank is visited here)

draw_exposure.note: 73 of 80 bots hold a sword and 69-70 hold a kit plant, so the draw only needs pools that bank and compost at all.

exposure.note: Ready = >= 1 canary _peaceful_kit active=1 row AND X2 >= 3 canary BOTS that composted a kit plant (verified inserts). The sword half (no craft, no bank, burn only while on) is deterministic tripwires K1/K3/K7 plus REPORTED burns (smelts are ~0.19/bot-h fleet-wide, so burns are never exposure-gated).

own_lines.note: LIVENESS: canary _peaceful_kit active=1 rows. BLOCKS KEEP (INCONCLUSIVE).
K0: a canary kit row with difficulty=peaceful and active=0, or mode != auto (the fleet env sets nothing).
K1 crafted(row, SWORD): a canary craft row whose requested item is a sword, success, gained, while that bot's kit row said active=1. A TRIPWIRE: ~1 sword craft/day fleet-wide, never exposure-gated.
POSITIVE CONTROL K1: crafted(row, TOOL) on control rows (72 in a 3 h dry run). BLOCKS KEEP.

K2 the sword LEDGER (rows sorted by snapshot time, row_times): canary falls not explained by a bank row's run interval, a CONFIRMED `_sword_fuel` burn / left-in-furnace row not marked restaged=1 (60 s before it, or a fall up to 180 s after it -- the kept sink credit), a death (-5..+180 s) or a same-name blip (<= 120 s); an 'outcome unknown' row credits nothing; breach when the canary's lost rate exceeds the control's, or any _compost row composted a sword. Proven on sandbox3 rows: real burns -> lost 0. A canary 'on the cursor at the close (the server drops it)' row is itself a breach. Drain rows added in rounds 11-12: a take that never answered is settled (cursor) before the drain stops; a sword it may have moved is 'outcome unknown (its take never answered)' (no credit -- if that sword later burns from a furnace with input left, K2 counts a loss: conservative, named here in case it ever fires); a drain stopped at a stuck cursor says '(the drain stopped at a stuck cursor)' (credited).
POSITIVE CONTROL K2: the same Ledger on control PICKAXES -- falls the bank reconciliation explained (18 in a 3 h dry run). BLOCKS KEEP.

K3 took(row, SWORD): a canary deposit/town_deposit row whose delta shows ANY sword leaving while that bot's kit row said active=1 (owner: swords are never stored in a peaceful world). A row whose run [start-5 s, end+5 s] holds that bot's `_death` (indexed before the walk) is excluded and counted.
K7 sword_burn: a `_sword_fuel` 'burned wooden_sword' row (confirmed or unconfirmed) whose own active= (the switch read at the put, which is the burn) is not 1 -- canary or control.
POSITIVE CONTROL K3: took(row, TOOL) on control bank rows (19 in a 6 h dry run: the base banks spare tool copies). BLOCKS KEEP.
POSITIVE CONTROL K7: burned_fuel(row) on control smelt rows -- a smelt that burned ordinary fuel (65 in a 6 h dry run). BLOCKS KEEP.

K4 reserve_breaches: a canary _compost row that composted a sapling species and holds fewer than its reserve (oak and birch 16; while active every other species 0, off 16), or apples and < 4, at END -- judged only on rows whose END bag is the visit's own; breach when the canary rate exceeds the control's.
POSITIVE CONTROL K4: control compost rows on which the reserve check was evaluated (21 in a 3 h dry run). BLOCKS KEEP.
K5 OFF MEANS OFF: composted_in(items, KIT) on a canary row whose kit row was not active=1 (or args.peaceful == 0), or on ANY control row.
POSITIVE CONTROL K5: composted_in(items, BASE + saplings + apple) on control rows (28 in a 3 h dry run). BLOCKS KEEP.
K6 ONLY THE LIST: off_list(items, BASE + KIT(36) + saplings + apple) on a canary row (carrot, potato, a sword ...).
POSITIVE CONTROL K6: off_list(items, BASE) on control rows (16 in a 3 h dry run: the base composts saplings and apples outside BASE). BLOCKS KEEP.

teardown.note: THREE STEPS: drop-ins, clear canary_pool, restart the pool's bots 12 s apart; then confirm exactly two versions live. No sword is banked any more. RECORD the read's 'left in the furnace' count by bot at teardown (Claude r-rev4): base code drains a furnace's fuel slot with a plain takeFuel, which mineflayer's putAway tosses from a full bag, so a wooden sword the canary left in a town furnace could later be dropped by a base bot. If it is non-zero, a one-time RCON READ of those furnaces (data get block, no edit) names them. Rows 'on the cursor at the close (the server drops it)' are named at teardown too (expected 0).
